user.title: Charger Setup
user.description: Configure your EV charger entity and current limits.

data_description.charger_current_entity: A number entity that controls the allowed charge current of the charge box (in Amperes).
data_description.min_current: The lowest current the charger accepts (typically 6 A for IEC 61851).
data_description.max_current: The highest current the charger is rated for.
data_description.voltage: Nominal line-to-neutral voltage (230 V in Europe, 120 V in North America).

solar.title: Solar / PV Setup
solar.description: Connect your Forecast.Solar sensors and optional real-time PV or grid power sensors.

data_description.forecast_solar_entities: One or more Forecast.Solar sensors covering your PV arrays. Their hourly watt forecasts are summed to build a solar charging plan.
data_description.pv_power_entity: Sensor reporting actual PV output in W or kW. When provided, used for real-time solar-excess decisions.
data_description.grid_power_entity: Sensor reporting grid power (positive = export to grid). When provided, the measured solar export is used instead of the estimate.

pricing.title: Electricity Pricing
pricing.description: Connect Nordpool (or compatible) price sensors for import and export to enable cost-aware charging.

data_description.nordpool_import_entity: Sensor whose state is the current all-in import spot price per kWh and whose attributes contain today's (and optionally tomorrow's) hourly prices.
data_description.nordpool_export_entity: Sensor whose state is the current all-in export spot price per kWh. Used as opportunity cost when solar excess is available.

ev.title: EV Battery
ev.description: Optionally connect entities from your car integration to let the manager calculate how many kWh remain until the target charge level is reached.

data_description.ev_battery_capacity_entity: Sensor or number entity reporting the usable battery capacity in kWh.
data_description.ev_target_soc_entity: Sensor or number entity reporting the desired charge level in %.
data_description.ev_soc_entity: Sensor or number entity reporting the current state of charge in %.
